detail: acceptance 11/11 --dev and non-dev; golden 10 passed, 28 xfailed (Phase 0 SUPPORTED f32 TILE)

what: Prompt says the op was removed from the working tree, but boundary commit 8fb00ecf is a prior ttnn-implementer Phase 0 of this same op, so a full g6_clone implementation sat in the working tree; the rules also forbid reading it there. Had to delete it unread and rewrite.
suggest: When re-running the implementer phase, nuke the prior implementer output (or set the boundary at the planner commit) before handing over the tree.

what: Output list mandates kernels/g6_clone_compute.cpp unconditionally while the binding design (and spec rule 1) has no compute kernel.
suggest: Make the compute kernel conditional on the design: list it only when the Block Operation Realization table names a compute-kernel operation.

what: No documented pattern for BB-07 descriptor caching in a Python generic op: where to put buffer addresses (common_runtime_args) and whether descriptor.kernels[i].common_runtime_args[j]=addr mutates the cached descriptor in place (it does: kernels list elements are references, VectorUInt32 is opaque). Needed a probe to confirm.
suggest: Add a short section: addresses in common_runtime_args slot 0, cache ProgramDescriptor by structural key, patch via descriptor.kernels[i].common_runtime_args[0] in place; generic_op hash ignores RT values.
